protocol.censor_rule: Within each run exclude rows 23,24,60 and every 37 rows beginning at 97 from AR estimation; retain all response rows and whiten continuously within each run.
protocol.decision: Only the declared long AR2 candidate can gain admission: its corrected and known-phi engines must satisfy every original exact binomial/TOST, recovery, whiteness, bootstrap variance-ratio and mean-bias margin in fresh confirmation. Other cases are retained adverse-domain diagnostics and confer no admission. Pilot/screen are engineering evidence only. No bounds, cases, seeds or budgets may be revised after outcomes; all failures remain in receipts.
protocol.design: Two alternating 4-second task epochs at onsets 6+32k, sampled at TR=1 and convolved with public SPMG1; run intercepts and six run-local DCT nuisance terms per run in high-nuisance cells.
metrics: mean absolute within-segment residual ACF at lags 1..4
null t and joint two-row F rejection at alpha .05
95% interval coverage for task_a in voxel 1
mean reported variance / empirical task_a estimator variance
protocol.noise: Independent Gaussian innovations with variance 1; continuous stationary AR noise within each run, independent run restarts after 256 burn-in draws. Censoring only affects estimator/whitener layout, not the data generator.
scope_limits: Gaussian stationary pure AR truth; homogeneous across four independent response columns
All responses retained, including rows excluded from lag estimation; this is estimation-only censoring, not physical observation removal
Non-contiguous selected source timepoints are refused under estimation-only continuity
Historical negative qualification receipts remain binding for their old recipes
No inference admission from pilot or screen
Only the declared long AR2 cell is eligible; no short-run or heterogeneous-voxel qualification.
protocol.seed_derivation: (root + domain*10000019 + (cell+1)*1000003 + replicate*7919) mod 2147483646 + 1; uniform generator Park-Miller 48271/2147483647, Gaussian Box-Muller
simulator_controls: innovation mean/variance and AR covariance against analytic AR(1)/AR(2) theory
noiseless coefficient recovery through public fit
independent run restart and censor-mask layout
known-phi inference controls in every confirmation cell
protocol.truth: Voxel 0 task coefficients are both 0; voxel 1 task_a is 0.75, task_b is -0.25; nuisance and intercept coefficients fixed; independent replicate datasets are the sampling units.
protocol.scientific_admission: Only ar2-high-censored-voxelwise-long-adaptive-continuous is eligible for admission after all original margins pass for corrected and known-phi controls in fresh confirmation. Short-run cells remain diagnostics with retained historical failures. No SE/df adjustment or new estimator is declared.
protocol.pairing: Domains51/52/53 for pilot/screen/confirmation; duration groups0/1 and root1427738621 are disjoint from historical/stationary/tail campaigns.
